Was a shot really fired during Dularchand Yadav’s funeral procession in Mokama?
In this ground report, our team captures the tense scenes at the funeral where emotions ran high and confusion spread. The report also looks at the growing political tension in the area and the questions being raised about Anant Singh’s role in the incident.
Khabargaon is a modern-day digital platform that helps you travel through current affairs, explainers, ground reports, interviews and unique video shows. Stay tuned for more and more!
